headline: WHAT’S THE PLAN?
body:
Open your plan.
Get to work.
caption: The hardest part of training shouldn’t be figuring out what to do. Open Gruntz, follow your plan, and get to work.

headline: STILL WAITING?
body:
A training plan you can
actually show up for.
caption: Motivation takes its time. Your training plan is ready when you are. Build your routine with Gruntz.

headline: LOST IN THE GYM?
body:
Log the sets.
Keep moving forward.
caption: Find your next session, log the work, and keep moving forward. Gruntz brings structure to your training.

headline: BRIEF. THEN LIFT.
body:
Track each set,
rep, and rest.
caption: A good brief deserves a good training session. Log your sets, reps, and rest with Gruntz.

headline: LOG THE WORK.
body:
Make the work
part of your record.
caption: Put the training on the record. Earn XP, build your routine, and see your progress with Gruntz.

headline: STAY ON COURSE.
body:
Show up. Earn XP.
See what adds up.
caption: Keep your training on course. Show up, earn XP, and see your progress in Gruntz.
